essence: The practitioner should feed brahmins and also give them garments, ornaments, and similar gifts.
One should constantly recite the mantra for a year while keeping the gaze fixed on the sun's disk.
Reciting the mantra one thousand and eight times makes the practitioner endowed with cows and fortune.
Through this practice the six actions succeed and the practitioner reaches Vishnu's supreme abode.
By recitation of this mantra, the divine descent here becomes a giver of fruits at all times.
